no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not present the perampanel NDA to an Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the FYCOMPA (perampanel) NDA 202834. The Medical Review states plainly that "The Division did not present the perampanel NDA to an Advisory Committee," and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review's "Advisory Committee Meeting" section records "None." The only "committee" references in the review documents are internal FDA bodies (the Carcinogenicity Assessment Committee and the Pediatric Review Committee), not an external advisory committee, so there were no AdComm concerns or resulting changes to the approval.
